truth_availability.why: data/corpus/EVALUATOR_BUNDLE.npz is absent (data/manifest.json not_shipped; CLAIM_INVENTORY sections 1 and 2 row 14). The truth fields y^AB, y^BA, delta_i, d_i and the training-mean contrast m are therefore unavailable at spatial resolution: 5 shipped per-frame scalars per unit cannot determine 256 unknowns.

truth_quantities_that_ARE_shipped.W (learner weights): data/learner_artifacts/weights_seed{0..4}.pt shipped but never loaded here; the analysis needs no weights

truth_availability.baselines_computable_why: both new baselines emit a raw order contrast of exactly zero, so their residual against truth is -delta_i and their q2 equals delta2, whose square root is shipped. No truth field is needed.
not_computed_because_truth_absent: arm-level (per-ordering) relative L2 and RMSE of the order-blind predictor
a truth-side order-blind reference as a distinct number (identical to the above on the contrast metric S; its arm-level metrics need the truth fields)
truth_availability.forbidden_substitution_not_made: no baseline was scored against the learner predictions in place of truth

metric.S: sqrt(mean_W q2) / sqrt(mean_W b2), per unit, then mean over 48 units

truth_scale_cross_file_agreement.note: sqrt(b2) from PATH_VS_EXPOSURE truth_scales vs S_OF_T units.b

additional_npz_consistency_check_not_a_g.meaning: links the shipped residual norms q2 and the shipped truth contrast norms delta2 to the actual npz predictions; NOT a predeclared gate
additional_npz_consistency_check_not_a_g.finding: seed 3 emits bit-identical pred_ab and pred_ba: it IS the order-blind predictor, not merely close to it. Its raw_S is exactly 1 and its margin against the order-blind / zero-contrast baseline is exactly 0 with a degenerate CI [0,0]. This was discovered after the gate was fixed and changes no threshold.

baseline_identity.note: predeclared in PREDECLARED.md 1(a): any predictor emitting one field for both orderings has zero raw contrast, so it scores identically to the zero-contrast control on S. Two motivations, one number.

gate.definition: PREDECLARED.md section 4: PASS iff, on the trajectory observable for the PRIMARY record (ensemble), the 95% CI of the paired margin S_learner - S_baseline lies entirely below 0 against all four fair baselines. Endpoint reported, not gated.

sensitivity_seed3.label: SENSITIVITY ONLY - not primary, does not replace the five-seed result
sensitivity_seed3.reason: a seed whose primitive recovery rises between checkpoints has diverged. Three or more such seeds is systematic and the remedy is a new frozen plan with annealing or tighter clipping, not a patch to this one. One such seed is a scatter result and is reported as one.

ensemble_without_seed3.reason: the four-seed ensemble residual needs the cross-seed spatial inner products mean_x(res_k . res_l), which require the truth field delta_i; EVALUATOR_BUNDLE.npz is not shipped. Only per-seed-averaged records (pooled, seed_error_pool) can be recomputed on a seed subset.
